note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It extends mask_rcnn_x101_32x4d_fpn_1x_coco.py via mmengine's read_base() and overrides the model backbone to use ResNeXt-101 64x4d instead of 32x4d. No CLI-invocable code exists.
read_base_import: read the mmengine config file that imports base settings from mask_rcnn_x101_32x4d_fpn_1x_coco
model_backbone_override: review the model dict that configures a ResNeXt-101 64x4d backbone for Mask R-CNN
resnext101_64x4d_config: summarize the ResNeXt backbone configuration with depth 101, groups 64, and base width 4
pretrained_init_cfg: review the PretrainedInit config that loads open-mmlab resnext101_64x4d checkpoint weights
fpn_mask_rcnn_config: summarize the Mask R-CNN FPN configuration using a ResNeXt-101 64x4d backbone on COCO
